subject.title: [Security] Missing complexity validation and rate limiting on log query filters

question: Does the authenticated audit-ledger query surface require an additional per-client rate limit, or should this report close because current main accepts only bounded scalar filters within the trusted operator boundary?
rationale: The reported recursive-filter primitive was not found, but deciding whether authenticated operator requests need an additional availability boundary is a security-policy choice that automation must not make under the protected label.

options.title: Close after boundary confirmation
options.body: Confirm that the RPC schema remains fixed and bounded, then close because the reported recursive-query path does not exist on current main.

options.title: Request a current-main proof
options.body: Ask for an exact authenticated request, query plan, repeat rate, and CPU or lock measurements demonstrating practical amplification before considering code changes.

options.title: Add gateway rate limiting
options.body: If authenticated audit-query flooding is in scope, apply a fixed-window limit at the gateway method and test normal queries plus rejection behavior.
